summary: Comprehensive testing of the NEW Credit Assessment & Loan Origination module. Backend: 19 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_credit.py all pass (RBAC, lenders CRUD, score-model config, application journey, consent gating, full run-all pipeline coherence, weak/strong applicant decisions, subvention models school_100/parent_100/shared, bank statement AI+manual, doc OCR, duplicate PAN fraud, full maker-checker-lender submission workflow with 403 for school_admin on checker, lender scoped visibility, dashboard KPIs, audit trail, PII masking). Regression /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py: 31 passed + 1 skipped (unchanged from iter2). Frontend UI (super_admin): 4-step wizard creates BLP-LN application, redirect to /credit/app/:id, Run full pre-credit assessment button triggers pipeline, all 9 tabs (overview/kyc/bureau/bank/score/decision/pricing/fraud/workflow) render populated data, audit trail visible in workflow tab, /credit/policies renders score-model editor with Σ=1.00 badge and all 4 lender accordions.
critical_code_review_comments: credit.py:649 pricing formula uses ambiguous expression: `(recommended and [l for l in lenders if l['id']==recommended['lender_id']][0]['policy']['processing_fee_pct'] or 1.5)`. When recommended exists but processing_fee_pct is 0 (falsy), Python's `or` will fall back to 1.5 — edge case bug for a 0% fee lender. Refactor to explicit conditional.

credit.py:_run_engines writes `a['status']='assessed'` but the aggregated doc is then persisted with $set of individual keys in /assess and /run-all — inconsistent status flow across handlers; consolidate.

credit.py get/list applications: STAFF role list is not scoped to school_admin's school for GET /applications/{id}. School admin can view ANY app by id (only listing is filtered). If tenant isolation matters, add school_id check on retrieve.
credit.py update_application uses `if v` filter which will drop legitimately-empty overrides (e.g., clearing co_applicant={}). Consider using explicit set semantics or None-check.
credit.py:_ai_bank_statement / _ai_ocr write to tempfile without cleanup; small leak but not critical.
credit.py file is 948 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting engines/models/routes into separate modules.
checker-decision endpoint only accepts 'approve'|'reject' via free-form string; use Literal in Pydantic to enforce.
submit-lender uses query-param lender_id but no body validation of body/lender existence for lender_id ordering — currently OK but consider consolidating into a Pydantic body model.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (wizard, run-all, all 9 tabs, policies page)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed idempotently creates 4 lenders (Axis/HDFC/ICICI/Aditya Birla NBFC), credit_config with default weights (sum=1.0) and commission_pct=1.5, credit_ops user and lender user bound to HDFC. Test file creates TEST_ prefixed apps with unique PANs per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_credit.py -v -o 'addopts=' (pytest.ini has -n auto which collides on module-scoped fixtures — use -o addopts= or run serial). Credit response uses 'token' key, NOT 'access_token'. Wizard test-ids: f-student-name, f-name, f-pan, f-income, f-loanamt, f-consent, wizard-next, wizard-submit. Detail page: run-assessment-btn, tab-{overview|kyc|bureau|bank|score|decision|pricing|fraud|workflow}, maker-submit-btn, checker-approve-btn, submit-lender-<id>. Policies: save-config-btn. Deterministic bureau PANs used in tests: AAAPS9999Z (strong ~good score), ZZZZW0001Z-4Z (any of 4 will land Refer/Reject due to weak income/geography/employment/age combo).
